about: CONCEPT composites, not photos of what is installed: the real Futures Learning Center photos (img/center/) with the proposed Futures Friends Learning Zones kit (zone mats, posters or zone signs, plush) composited in locally with Python (Pillow/OpenCV/numpy) from the brand art. No generative model, no people. Owner 2026-10-07: "They need our hypothetical carpets and our posters added so they're branded with our stuff." Always shown with the label below and the plain real photo one tap away (brand-art.js photo(): Real room / With the kit). Served at 400/800/1200 px as WebP + JPEG, metadata stripped.
